result.markdown:
For most small support teams, **Help Scout is my top recommendation**\. It offers a good balance of simplicity, shared inbox management, automation, knowledge-base tools, and customer experience without the complexity of an enterprise help desk.

However, the best choice depends on your team size, support channels, and budget.
